newsitem.title: ITALY: S&P puts Cofiri ratings on CreditWatch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Cofiri ratings on CreditWatch.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had put the ratings of Italian financial group Cofiri SpA, a unit of industrial holding IRI, on CreditWatch with negative implications.

It said in a statement from Paris received in Rome that the move affected Cofiri's A-2 short-term issuer rating and the A-2 Eurodollar commercial paper programme rating of Cofiri International Inc, a unit of the Italian group.

Standard & Poor's said the action followed an announcement by the Italian Treasury that new management of state-owned IRI, appointed on Monday, had been charged with winding up the industrial holding within three years and selling its assets.
"This announcement is potentially material to the Cofiri ratings, which are based on sovereign support for IRI SpA," the statement said.
"Standard & Poor's expects to promptly obtain sufficient information concerning the Italian government's future plans for IRI and Cofiri, to resolve the CreditWatch action," it added.
